Controlled. Professional. Accountable.

Secure movement support you can plan around.

Romanien Protection Limited can provide escort and specialised movement support for authorised assignments, subject to client requirements, risk assessment, personnel availability and all applicable Papua New Guinea laws and licensing requirements.

Each assignment begins with a confidential discussion to understand the movement, operating environment and appropriate level of protection. Our approach prioritises prevention, professionalism and the safety of everyone involved.

Service may include

  • Pre-assignment risk assessment and movement planning
  • Professional escort personnel for approved movements
  • Vehicle and route coordination
  • Client liaison and communication arrangements
  • Incident escalation and post-assignment reporting

Risk-led planning

Assignments are assessed before deployment, with clear scope, responsibilities and safety procedures.

Professional conduct

Personnel are expected to maintain discipline, discretion, respectful conduct and accountability.

Compliance first

Any armed component is considered only where lawful, properly licensed and authorised. No deployment is implied by this service description.

Important: Armed escort services are subject to applicable laws, permits, licensing, insurance and operational approvals in Papua New Guinea. Availability must be confirmed directly with Romanien Protection Limited. This page is a service description, not a guarantee that armed deployment is currently licensed or available.
